episodeTitle.en: How to speak more confidently and persuasively | Matt Abrahams (professor, speaker, author)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何更自信、更有说服力地表达 | 马特·亚伯拉罕斯（教授、演讲家、作家）

guestBioOfficial.en: Matt Abrahams is a renowned communication expert, with decades of teaching, coaching, and consulting experience. At Stanford University, he teaches a business school class on strategic communication. Beyond academia, he’s a sought-after keynote speaker and consultant, guiding presenters from IPO road shows to prestigious platforms like TED, the World Economic Forum, and the United Nations. His acclaimed podcast, Think Fast, Talk Smart, garners millions of listeners, and his book, Think Faster, Talk Smarter, equips speakers with practical skills for impromptu success. With a previous bestseller, Speaking Up Without Freaking Out, Matt has empowered countless individuals to speak confidently and authentically. In our conversation, we discuss: • The concept of “daring to be dull”
guestBioOfficial.zh: 马特·亚伯拉罕斯是知名的沟通专家，拥有数十年的教学、指导和咨询经验。在斯坦福大学，他教授战略沟通方面的商学院课程。除学术领域外，他还是备受追捧的主题演讲者和顾问，指导过从IPO路演到TED、世界经济论坛和联合国等知名平台的演讲者。他的广受好评的播客《快速思考，明智表达》吸引了数百万听众，他的著作《更快思考，更聪明表达》为演讲者提供了即兴成功的实用技能。凭借此前畅销书《无惧发声》，马特帮助无数人自信而真实地表达。在我们的对谈中，我们将探讨：• “敢于平庸”的概念

title.en: How to speak more confidently and persuasively | Matt Abrahams (professor, speaker, author)
title.zh: 如何更自信、更有说服力地表达 | 马特·亚伯拉罕斯（教授、演讲家、作家）

summary.en: Matt teaches that you must "prepare to be spontaneous" through practice, just like athletes or jazz musicians. He recommends visualization to calm anxiety and striving for connection over perfection by "daring to be dull." The episode is a practical toolkit for communicating clearly and confidently in the moment.
summary.zh: 马特指出，你必须像运动员或爵士乐手那样，通过练习来"为即兴做准备"。他推荐用可视化来缓解焦虑，并通过"敢于平淡"来追求连接而非完美。本期是一套关于在当下清晰、自信沟通的实用工具箱。
